description: Get a PostgreSQL connection string for a Neon database with all parameters being optional

branchId.description: Optional ID of the branch to connect to; when omitted, the project's default branch is used.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database to connect to; when omitted, the project's default database is used.

pooled.description: Optional flag: when true, return a pooled connection string (through Neon's connection pooler); when false or omitted, return a direct connection string.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project whose connection string to return.

roleName.description: Optional name of the database role to connect as; when omitted, the default role is used.

name: get_connection_string
